title: How does automatic survey publishing work?
intent: This article explains how automatic survey publishing activates and deactivates surveys based on configured dates.
short_answer: If automatic publishing is enabled and a start date is set, EUSurvey automatically activates the survey when the start date is reached. Similarly, if an end date is set, the survey automatically stops accepting contributions. The scheduler checks hourly.
procedure: The system activates/deactivates at the specified dates.
important_conditions: Scheduler runs hourly to check dates.
Survey must be published first for auto-activation.
troubleshooting: Survey not activating: Ensure automatic publishing is enabled AND the survey is published.
